This mission will require that you destroy two fully outfitted and operational Corvettes. These are the types of ships you will find when traveling the galaxy. You will also have at your disposal two Lightning Strike Fighters, which are stored in your Lightning Bay. To use them, press "w" until Lightning Bay appears in the Secondary Weapon window. Launch them with "Shift", or your Fire Secondary key. When both have been launched, select a target, then press "f" to have your fighters attack that target. Press "v" to have your fighters hold position, "c" to have them regroup in formation, and "opt-c" to have them return to their bays. When you have destroyed the two ships, return to Levo. Good luck.
